observations.source: Nested addition case from BITEX test document, section Errors / Stack Error. Native PLUS confirms Stack ERROR for 12 nested operands.
observations.boundary: 10 saved left operands plus the current register are accepted: 11 nested operands give 66. The twelfth raises Stack ERROR. Flat sum 1..12 gives 78; nested multiplication of 12 ones also gives Stack ERROR.
observations.scroll: MathI input scrolls horizontally in 8-pixel increments. Caret positions 180,176,174,179 were measured on the distinct expressions.
observations.timeout: Derivative Abs(x^2-3x+2) at x=1 gives Time Out. Back preserves the expression. The two-pixel closing-parenthesis gap after trailing Abs was measured.
observations.language: Both Vietnamese and English Stack/Time Out error titles and Back labels were captured directly.
